brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage by wind-blown debris, leaf litter, nesting material, and accumulated dust in accordance with SOP-015, ensuring any obstruction above one quarter of the free area is cleared before the forecast heat event. The supplied documents do not cover the specific maintenance history or cooling configuration of this ONAN unit with regard to forced cooling de-ratings or open work orders under SOP-016. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period pursuant to MG-021.
